definitions.gloss: one's favorite person (especially idol or character)
definitions.explanation: A person, character, or thing that one strongly supports or is a fan of. From the verb {推|お}す (to recommend/support).

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}の{推|お}しはこのアイドルです。
{推|お}しのグッズを{集|あつ}めています。
examples.english: I collect merchandise of my favorite.

examples.japanese: {推|お}しの{誕生日|たんじょうび}をお{祝|いわ}いしました。

notes: Originally from idol fandom culture, now widely used. Related expressions: {推|お}し{活|かつ} (fan activities), {推|お}しメン (favorite member), {推|お}し{変|へん} (changing one's favorite). Also used as a prefix: {推|お}し{色|いろ} (color associated with one's favorite).
